fixed.summary: A gale's sea had almost no foam: its foam levels lie far out in the tail of the surface's folding, and the fixed gain reached a tenth to a fifth of full. The gain now follows how close the surface lies under each level, so a 20 m/s sea carries whitecaps and a breeze's sea gains a few. Over the shoals the least gain holds, so the surf zone does not whiten to the beach. Old foam stays open at its rim and in its body instead of filling its patch flat, and spray puffs are broken clouds of droplets, not even discs. At dusk and at night foam and spray are as bright as the sky lights them: they took the twilight's fourfold lift of the image-based light, which the sea's mirror already left out, and glowed white on a dark sea.
